name: Use a Recovery Code
summary: A user with an outstanding TOTP MFA requirement chooses recovery-code authentication and the client opens the recovery-code entry surface without changing authentication state.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.totp is visible for an already identified durable identity with an outstanding MFA requirement

postconditions.expression: session-capability remains anonymous and auth.continue.recovery is visible for the same identified durable identity

sourceReferences.note: React Native already contains the destination presentation shell, but the entry action from ContinueTotpScreen is not yet implemented.
